prompt:
You are watching a volleyball match from a fixed camera.

This clip begins at {start} seconds into the match.

List ONLY specific meaningful volleyball events in live play. Be extremely strict to avoid over-reporting.
1. IGNORE all dead-ball touches, practice hits, and casual returns between points.
2. In volleyball, a team typically touches the ball 3 times (defend -> pass -> attack). You MUST IGNORE the intermediate passes and normal sets. Only report the first defensive contact and the hit over the net.

For each event give:
  t       - the precise time the player physically strikes the ball
  type    - must be one of:
            serve: the initial hit from the baseline that starts a rally
            receive: the first contact defending a serve
            dig: the first contact defending an attack
            set: ONLY an assist that directly precedes a 'kill' (IGNORE ALL OTHER PASSES)
            attack: an offensive hit sent over the net that does not score a point
            kill: an attack that directly scores a point and ends the rally
            block: deflecting an attack at the net
  side    - "left" or "right": which half of the frame the player is standing in
  number  - the player's jersey number as a string, or null if you cannot read it
  error   - true if the touch was a mistake
  point   - true if the rally ended here and a point was scored
